get.summary: Get Cyclops usage for a project resource
get.description: Resource usage for one LEXIS Project Resource, taken from the external Cyclops accounting service. The request never reaches this handler in a deployed system: the Gateway intercepts every /api/Other/CyclopsUsage/ path, checks the caller's permissions, resolves the project short name to a Cyclops customer id, forwards fromDate and toDate as the Cyclops from/to window together with that customer id, and returns the Cyclops response. It answers 400 when the project and resource segments are missing, 404 when no Cyclops customer matches the project, and 500 when the Cyclops credentials or the Cyclops customer lookup are unavailable. This route exists in Core only so the operation is published and RBAC-mapped; called directly it accepts the request and returns no content.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start of the usage window, forwarded to Cyclops as 'from'. Omit for the Cyclops default window.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End of the usage window, forwarded to Cyclops as 'to'. Omit for the Cyclops default window.

parameters.name: ProjectShortName
parameters.description: LEXIS Project Short-Name. Resolved by the Gateway to the matching Cyclops customer; the match is by customer name and is case-insensitive.

get.summary: Get the HEAppE command templates available to a "LEXIS Project"
get.description: Gets the HEAppE command templates available to the "LEXIS Project", collected from every HEAppE instance behind the project's resources using the caller's own bearer token. Results are cached; the response is served from the cache unless noCache is set. HEAppE instances that did not answer are not an error: their templates are simply absent from the body, and the instances are named in the X-Unavailable-HEAppE-Instances response header so a caller can tell why a cluster looks unavailable.

parameters.name: noCache
parameters.description: Pass true to bypass both cache layers (TemplatesInfo and HEAppE clusters) and query HEAppE directly without storing the result; the existing cached entry is left untouched.

post.summary: Settle a "LEXIS Project" request from its emailed action link
post.description: Settles a "LEXIS Project" resource-assignment request from one of the two single-use action links generated for it and sent to the person who has to decide. The route is unauthenticated: possession of the link is the credential. Which link is presented decides the outcome — the accept link accepts the request, the reject link declines it with an empty reason. Handling then burns EVERY live action link of that request, the accept and the reject link alike, so neither can be replayed. A link that is unknown, already burned or past its validity window does not resolve and the request fails. Returns 200 with "Request was handled" when the link settled the request, and 400 when the link carried neither action.

parameters.name: actionLink
parameters.description: The single-use action link identifier taken from the emailed accept or reject URL.

get.summary: Get the public summary of a "LEXIS Project" resource-assignment request
get.description: Returns the unauthenticated summary an action-link landing page needs to present the decision: the "LEXIS Project" short name, the "LEXIS Project Resource" name, the "LEXIS Provider", the requester's user name and e-mail, the request state and validity, and BOTH action links — accept and reject — so the page can offer the two buttons. It is served only while the request is still actionable, and is otherwise refused with a 400 validation problem naming the reason: the request must still be pending (not yet accepted or rejected), it must be of type ProjectResourceAssignment, and its action links must not have expired longer ago than the configured action-link duration. The request must also still have exactly its two live action links.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Identifier (GUID) of the "LEXIS Project" request the action links belong to.
